comments.author: Taipan
comments.body: First of all, only farms at Ascension or Savali can have orchards capable of producing Resin. If your farm is at one of those two places, click the Private Farm link at the bottom of the Homepage, then click where your farm is. Notice that for each farm island there is only one of the four possible outcomes you can get that will produce Resin when you fully develop an Orchard. For both islands, you can get this with the first Orchard you develop, but, it's a one in four chance you'll get it. If you're farm is on Ascension, and you're first production shows as Apricot Seeds, then keep that and let it produce for 10 days, after that you can switch to Resin production.

comments.author: Visitor
comments.body:
You may see most of the possible farm plots and their yield tables listed at this location.

Private Farm

It is also linked on the front page of this site, at the very bottom, under "Private Farm" as well. It would be more convenient to have that link at the top of the site, I think... Regardless, there are some recent updates not shown here on the DB, like the ability of Ascension Island farms to now grow Mandrakes, and the fifth farm located in the Bering Strait is not listed at all. For those, you will have to visit the Japanese wiki and translate it, or hope someone will post information in English. The wiki in question is found here.

gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Privatefarm

As Taipan said, however, only Ascension Island and St. Lucia have Resin producing farm plots at this time. You can see their Resin icon listed under both farms' pages, along with their other possible yields, such as Apricot seeds.
